title.zh: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
title.en: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months

current_state.zh: French authorities recorded 90 crypto-related cases of kidnapping, extortion, threats and violent theft between January 1 and mid-August 2026, alongside 223 arrests and 126 imprisonments, making France the leading hotspot for physical attacks on crypto holders.
